description: This file contains tests for the channels command, specifically testing the output of channel status, including runtime errors for signal and iMessage channels. It imports testing utilities, plugin creators, and formatting functions, and defines test cases to verify error reporting in channel statuses.

methods.name: collectStatusIssues
methods.description: Collects status issues from the last error for the signal plugin

methods.name: setActivePluginRegistry
methods.description: Sets the active plugin registry for testing

methods.name: createIMessageTestPlugin
methods.description: Creates a test plugin for iMessage channel

methods.name: createChannelTestPluginBase
methods.description: Creates a base test plugin for channels

methods.name: createTestRegistry
methods.description: Creates a test plugin registry with given plugins

methods.name: formatGatewayChannelsStatusLines
methods.description: Formats the channel status lines for output, including errors
